audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven full-layer sides read 'Skill' while content win[] and the packet levelChart both read Diana, Diana, Katarina, Diana, Diana, Diana, Diana.
audit.why: Katarina has no gap-closer until Shunpo at level 3, so Diana owns levels 1-2 with a 900-range Q; level 3 is Katarina's on the Shunpo-plus-dagger reset chain; from 4 on Diana's mark-dash and then Moonfall against a channelled Death Lotus put the rows back.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides brought onto the content values, every why rewritten to match its verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes carried no numbers and phases[5].why claimed the combo 'chunks half bars'.
audit.why: Shunpo is 12/11/10/9/8; Death Lotus 75/60/45; Diana's Moonfall 100/90/80. The half-bar magnitude has no source in either kit.
audit.corrected: Spikes keyed to Shunpo at 12s and Death Lotus at 75s; the magnitude replaced with the free Lunar Rush reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated, and the page repeatedly claimed Diana's Q-mark 'denies her E blink targets' (whys[5], spikes[2], mid, wants.you[1]) — nothing in either kit supports that.
audit.why: Death Lotus is a channel, so Moonfall's pull and slow interrupt it — that is the level 6 interaction and it was missing. The real value of the Moonlight mark is on Diana's side: Lunar Rush has no cooldown onto a marked target, so Diana re-dashes onto Katarina wherever Shunpo (725 range, 12s at rank 1) puts her. Voracity refunds her cooldowns on any nearby kill she damaged, which is what makes chasing through a wave dangerous.
audit.corrected: Moonfall-interrupts-Death-Lotus stated; the unsupported blink-denial claim replaced everywhere with the free Lunar Rush reset; Voracity named in the don't.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d called Shunpo a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Shunpo is 12s at rank 1 and 8s at rank 5 — never 15s. Bouncing Blade is 11s at rank 1, Death Lotus 75s, Diana's Pale Cascade 15s.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; the wrong 15s claim removed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sixteen misgender findings (Katarina called he/his) plus two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad).
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists katarina as female; the bleeds put trade text under disengage and wave-chasing titles.
audit.corrected: All flagged fields rewritten with she/her and with bodies that match their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two derived flags in the kit file contradict Riot's own description and were not used anywhere — correctly, but they are worth recording.
audit.why: Katarina's Q carries a 'grounding' flag and her W a 'knockup' flag; Riot's text says the dagger 'ricochets onto the ground' and that she 'tosses a Dagger into the air', which is what the tooltip parser caught. Katarina grounds nobody and knocks nobody up.
audit.corrected: Nothing written that relies on either flag.

Your Moonlight mark is the other half — Lunar Rush costs nothing onto a marked target, so wherever her 12-second Shunpo puts her, you are already there. Group for objectives where you can burst her before she resets off multiple targets.

notes: Chart was fully disagreeing across layers: six full-layer sides read 'Skill' against content win[] and the packet, which agreed with each other. I moved the full layer onto the content values, so no paired win[N] edits exist to propose — the content side was already right. Final chart both layers: Diana, Diana, Katarina, Diana, Diana, Diana, Diana. Ratings left untouched. The packet's suspectName 'Pale Cascade's' in content late is a false positive — that is Diana's own W and the text is correct. Two derived-flag misfires recorded in the audit: Katarina's Q is flagged 'grounding' and her W 'knockup'; Riot's descriptions say the dagger ricochets onto the ground and that she tosses a dagger into the air, so neither flag is real and nothing was written from them.
